title: Arc Builders Fund
description: Circle Ventures' initiative backing early-stage teams building real-world financial apps and services that can only exist on Arc: capital, hands-on support from Arc's core teams, and introductions to an investor network. Teams apply by submitting an investor deck; no deadline is stated.
reward: Capital from Circle Ventures for select companies, plus hands-on support from Arc's core teams (amount not stated)

eligibility.note: a real-world financial app or service that can only exist on Arc

rules: Rolling: submit your investor deck on arc.io for Builders Fund consideration. No deadline is stated.
For teams building real-world financial apps and services that can only exist on Arc.
Circle looks for early-stage teams whose products need Arc's unique attributes and who can show a path to real use cases, ideally building primitives other Arc projects can compose with.
"Arc Builders Fund" is a label for a Circle Ventures internal initiative, not a fund. Any capital is deployed by Circle Ventures at its sole discretion; no amount is published.
Investor Network members are third-party firms with no commitment to invest.
